description: This file contains helper functions for the SuiteCRM portal, including functions to retrieve related bugs, cases, notes, and accounts, as well as user authentication and session management. It defines modules, functions for related data retrieval, and session handling specific to the SuiteCRM portal integration.

methods.name: get_bugs_in_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves bugs related to contacts based on contact IDs, optionally ordered.

methods.name: get_bugs_in_accounts
methods.description: Retrieves bugs related to accounts based on account IDs, optionally ordered.

methods.name: get_cases_in_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves cases related to contacts based on contact IDs, optionally ordered.

methods.name: get_cases_in_accounts
methods.description: Retrieves cases related to accounts based on account IDs, optionally ordered.

methods.name: get_notes_in_contacts
methods.description: Retrieves notes related to contacts based on contact IDs, optionally ordered.

methods.name: get_notes_in_module
methods.description: Retrieves notes related to a specific module and parent IDs, optionally ordered.

methods.name: get_related_in_module
methods.description: Retrieves related records in a module, with support for custom queries, ordering, and limits.

methods.name: get_accounts_from_contact
methods.description: Retrieves account IDs related to a contact.

methods.name: get_contacts_from_account
methods.description: Retrieves contact IDs related to an account.

methods.name: get_related_list
methods.description: Builds a list of related records based on IDs, templates, and conditions.

methods.name: build_relationship_tree
methods.description: Builds a relationship tree for a contact, retrieving related accounts and contacts.

methods.name: get_contacts_in
methods.description: Returns session-stored list of viewable contacts.

methods.name: get_accounts_in
methods.description: Returns session-stored list of viewable accounts.

methods.name: get_module_in
methods.description: Returns a session-based list of IDs for a module, formatted for queries.

methods.name: set_module_in
methods.description: Sets session variables for a module's related IDs based on provided list.

methods.name: login_user
methods.description: Authenticates a user for the portal using username and password.

methods.name: portal_get_entry_list_limited
methods.description: Retrieves a limited list of entries for a module, with session and access control.
